messages:
ruth: Heads-up: sketching a new compact layout that moves reviewer gist into the left gutter as an initial. Trying to keep scan speed high but avoid losing the 'why'.
omar: Left gutter could work visually but watch for truncation. Gutter space is tight on narrow viewports.
claire: For narrow screens we should collapse to initials + a `…` reveal button instead of full word. Screen reader needs a visible control.
mike: Also think about the undo affordance: if someone approves quickly, we should show a 10s snackbar with `Undo` and include reviewer-note preview there.
ruth: Microcopy ideas for snackbar: `Approved 3 items. Note: "{first 60 chars}" [Undo]` or `Approved — add note`? Which is less noisy?
omar: Prefer the first. Makes the reviewer note explicit. Also keep the primary CTA text consistent: `Confirm approval` across flows.
claire: a11y: ensure the reveal button has aria-expanded and the gutter region has aria-label like `Reviewer note for diff {id}`. When you open reveal, focus should go into the panel.
a11y-bot: Accessibility additions:
- Use role="status" for the snackbar announcement and include note preview in polite live region.
- If note is truncated, provide a `Show full note` button that reads aloud full content on activation.
- When undo is clicked, announce `Approval undone for {n} items` and return focus to the nearest diff.
mike: Keyboard mapping: Enter on approve opens note draft; Shift+Enter submits immediately (power user), fallback for others.
ruth: Action list: Omar mock gutter + reveal, Mike prototype snackbar/undo + keyboard, Claire to draft aria labels, a11y to validate announcements. I'll drop mocks to figma and tag you.
omar: Mock link: https://figma.redwood/gutter-reveal-compact-1
claire: I'll write the aria-label examples in PRD: `Reviewer note: concise — reveal details`
ruth: Thanks team. Quick test next week with 4 keyboard-first folks. :sparkles:
